card.name: mL in drug concentrations
card.fires_on: The unit mL (or L after m) right after an amount like mg or mcg, in concentration statements such as 50 mg per mL. Also fires, more weakly, on 'daily' after a frequency like 3 or 4 times.

modes.label: Concentration unit
modes.description: mL completing a per-volume strength after a dose amount.
modes.example: Nabi-HB contains not more than 40 micrograms per<< mL>> IgA.

modes.label: Slash before mL
modes.description: The /mL piece after a drug amount in strengths and dilutions.
modes.example: aseptically withdraw the required amount of docetaxel injection (20 mg docetaxel<</mL>>) with a calibrated syringe

modes.label: Daily after times
modes.description: The word daily closing a dosing frequency phrase.
modes.example: instilled into the affected ear 3 or 4 times<< daily>>.

card.writes: It supplies the volume unit that ends a concentration and discourages another 'per' or 'daily' style word from following.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug strength like mg per mL is being completed with the volume unit.
